name: gatetarn
note: Station 2 (PLAN.md sections 4 and 5, Oasis 1; section 7.4): the Tarn of the Gate-Bell, on the model's tarn (3,680 m) at its north-east shore, px 1014.5,1234.5 (region/station-gatetarn.json). Its 44s-host-site.js replaces src/'s: the cirque's basalt headwall (KRELIEF.scarp), the brook off the hanging bench and its fall, the moraine damming the tarn's east shore, the rockfall heaps under the wall.
